rationale: Both candidates miss the actual human review threads (test-utility trigger noise already resolved by the author, functional-test redundancy, trigger-frequency rationale) and both wrongly recommend re-adding run_benchmark.py/conftest.py to source_file_dependencies — exactly what the author explicitly removed for good reason, so recall is low and roughly equal. Precision and depth favor Y slightly: it independently reaches the same core finding as X (no baseline assertion/upload despite the PR's stated purpose) but adds well-grounded extra catches (L4-only perf-JSON convention violation, double execution during NIGHTLY e2e builds, A3 dataset-cache cost) and gives a concrete copy-pasteable YAML fix, making it marginally more actionable than X's more evidence-heavy but repetitive citations.
